This side event aims to facilitate dialogue on these emerging issues and identify considerations for future international cooperation.Register to watch online.

daily_top5.summary: Health emergencies—including disease outbreaks, pandemics, climate-related events, humanitarian crises, and natural disasters—are increasing in frequency and complexity.
